# Fromage & Figue

> Fromage & Figue is an artisan fromagerie and delicatessen in Liverpool, founded by Benoit Severin-Delos. It sells French and European cheeses, bread and pantry goods, hand-composed cheese boards, gift boxes and gift vouchers, for free collection in store or delivery. The shop has not opened yet: it is opening Spring 2027, Liverpool. The website is a work in progress.

## Key facts
- Address: 14 Gambier Lane, Liverpool L1 4DX
- Contact: hello@fromageandfigue.co.uk, 0151 496 0142
- Opening hours (once open): Tuesday to Friday 10:00 to 18:00; Saturday 09:00 to 17:00; closed Monday and Sunday
- Collection from the shop is free. Delivery costs £4.99, and is free on orders over £60. Delivery takes 1 to 3 days.
- Collection times can only be booked for days and times the shop is open.

## Pages
- [Fromage & Figue](https://fromageandfigue.co.uk/): An artisan fromagerie and delicatessen opening soon in Liverpool, founded by Benoit Severin-Delos. Exceptional cheeses, boards and gift boxes.
- [Blog](https://fromageandfigue.co.uk/blog/): Stories, recipes and notes from the counter at Fromage & Figue, written by Benoit. The first posts are coming soon.
- [Main Collection](https://fromageandfigue.co.uk/collection): Browse the full Fromage & Figue collection of soft, hard and blue cheeses, bread and pantry goods. Free collection in Liverpool, or delivered.
- [Boards & Gifts](https://fromageandfigue.co.uk/gifts): Hand-composed cheese boards, gift boxes, hampers and gift vouchers from Fromage & Figue in Liverpool. Collect free in store, or have it delivered.
- [Pairing Guide](https://fromageandfigue.co.uk/pairing): Wine, cider and dishes to pair with every cheese on the counter, chosen by Benoit. Find your pairing, then add the cheese to your order.

## Main Collection
### Soft
- Brie de Meaux: £9 per 100g. Supple and creamy, with notes of mushroom and cream. Best at room temperature.
- Reblochon: £9 per 100g. Washed rind, supple and nutty, with a gentle fruit.
- Fresh goat cheese: £7 per 100g. Bright and lemony, with a delicate, soft texture.
- Camembert de Normandie: £8 per piece. Rich and earthy, with a melting centre. Excellent baked.

### Hard
- Comté 24 months: £8 per 100g. Nutty and caramel sweet, with fine crystals and a long finish.
- Manchego: £7 per 100g. Buttery sheep's milk cheese from La Mancha, with a gentle nuttiness.

### Blue
- Roquefort: £10 per 100g. Bold and salty over a creamy blue. Superb with honey.
- Gorgonzola Dolce: £8 per 100g. Mild, spoonable and rich.

### Pantry
- Walnut bread: £6 per loaf. Baked daily, an excellent partner for blue cheese.
- Fresh figs: £6 per box. Seasonal, and picked ripe.
- Fig jam: £9 per jar. Small batch, slowly cooked.
- Preserves and crackers: from £5. Small-batch preserves, crackers and nuts, chosen to sit alongside the cheese.

## Boards and gifts
### Cheese boards
- The Petite Board: £45 per board. Three cheeses, bread and a preserve on an oak board.
- The Classic Board: £85 per board. Five cheeses, bread, nuts and a preserve, composed by Benoit.
- The Grand Board: £150 per board. Seven cheeses with bread, fruit, nuts and preserves, for a crowd.

### Gift boxes and hampers
- The Tasting Box: £38 per box. Three cheeses, crackers and a preserve, wrapped and ribboned.
- The Evening Box: £65 per box. Four cheeses, bread, honey and a preserve for a slow evening.
- The Hamper: £120 per hamper. A generous mixed hamper of cheeses and pantry goods.

### Gift vouchers
- Gift voucher, £25: £25 per voucher. A voucher for the shop, in a black envelope.
- Gift voucher, £50: £50 per voucher. A voucher for the shop, in a black envelope.
- Gift voucher, £100: £100 per voucher. A voucher for the shop, in a black envelope.
